opening_condition: Mae, carrying the dented anchor-heart alone, has refused Orra's conditional command but enters Crown works to verify the sacrifice calculation; capeless Dax returns to South Hook with no breath-knot and no claim on Mae's trust.
objective: Verify Orra's load math, keep South Hook alive through the dawn detachment order, and put the true sacrifice plan where the city can see it.

Mae has explicitly refused Orra's offer of command on Orra's terms.
